steps.desc: New `poll_and_drain` step kind: fused poll + interleaved drain of a growing list (newItems = drainPath - processed) running the inner per-item step immediately; exit on `until` success AND drained; in-process vs externalize wait. Profile model + RunPollAndDrainStepAsync.
Shared item-failure tolerance policy (skip + per-item retry budget + transient-vs-permanent + max_failure_ratio) used by BOTH for_each and poll_and_drain.
Terminal-status classification: fail_states set (ERROR/FAILED/CANCELLED) + resource-gone (404 -> restart fresh) on poll_and_drain (and poll_until where sensible).
best_effort flag on hydrate/fetch: on sub-fetch failure emit collected records / skip batch + continue, instead of failing the stream (distinct from P2).

Checkpoint/resume: persist processed-item set + captured handles + poll anchor; resume restores and continues draining idempotently (no re-download/skip). Reuse the per-emit-target page counter for inner fetches.
Update integrations/tenable-io.yaml findings (and assets if apt) to poll_and_drain.

Tests (in-process harness): interleaved drain during PROCESSING, item tolerance (skip+retry+ratio abort), fail_state + 404-restart, best_effort hydrate, resume mid-drain. Build clean; full suite green; conformance + remediation intact.
Live Tenable findings via poll_and_drain: chunk GETs interleaved with status polls (not all-after-FINISHED), contiguous findings_000001..N.
